## Validation

List the checks, tests, or manual scenarios used to validate the change.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change has a focused scope and no unrelated edits.
- [ ] Tests cover new or changed behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Public behavior and examples are documented.
- [ ] New dependencies include a purpose and license review.
- [ ] Examples and fixtures contain no credentials, personal data, internal names, or confidential content.
- [ ] Security-sensitive changes follow the private reporting policy.
